Reasoning count: Count according to the visible components: there are 6 C–C bonds within the six-membered ring; the connections between the ring and the substituents include 1 C–F bond and 2 C–N bonds, for a total of 3; the two NO2 groups each have 2 N–O bonds, for a total of 4; in the separate amine fragment there is 1 R–N bond, and N–H bonds are not counted. Therefore the total is 6 + 3 + 4 + 1 = 14.

method.method_draft: Count by components visible in the transition-state drawing: the six-membered ring has 6 C–C bonds; the ring substituent connections are C–F plus two C–N bonds to NO2 groups, giving 3 more; the two NO2 groups each contain 2 N–O bonds, giving 4; the separate amine fragment has one R–N bond. Excluding N–H bonds and ignoring arrows, add 6 + 3 + 4 + 1 = 14.
